headline: Ventas (NYSE:VTR) Beats Q2 Estimates, Shares Slide on Aggressive Capital Deployment
summary: Ventas (VTR) beat Q2 estimates but shares fell 8% as investors weighed dilution from a $4.5B investment pipeline, despite raised FFO guidance.

headline: Ventas Reports 2026 Second Quarter Results
summary: CHICAGO, July 29, 2026--Ventas, Inc. (NYSE: VTR) ("Ventas" or the "Company") today reported results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026.
